g.text: If-Sr information structure: Events & the record
PlanEvaluated { plan: PlanId, verdict: VerdictSummary, engines: Vec<String>, }
Quarantined { sensor: SensorId, reason: String, stamps: Option<crate::ClockStamps>, }
ModeChanged { sensor: crate::SensorId, from: crate::SensorMode, to: crate::SensorMode, at: MissionTime, }
Correlated { track: TrackId, entity: crate::identity::GlobalEntityId, confidence: f64, basis: String, at: MissionTime, }
Minted { track: TrackId, entity: crate::identity::GlobalEntityId, at: MissionTime, }
ReferenceObserved { sensor: SensorId, reference: String, truth_enu: [f64; 3], observed_enu: [f64; 3], observation_variance_m2: [f64; 3], at: MissionTime, }
RegistrationApplied { sensor: SensorId, offset_enu: [f64; 3], residual_spread_m: f64, references: u32, at: MissionTime, }
RegistrationRefused { sensor: SensorId, reason: String, at: MissionTime, }
Issued { task: SensorTaskId, sensor: SensorId, at: MissionTime, }
Acknowledged { task: SensorTaskId, sensor: SensorId, at: MissionTime, }
Failed { task: SensorTaskId, sensor: SensorId, reason: String, at: MissionTime, }
Unacknowledged { task: SensorTaskId, sensor: SensorId, at: MissionTime, }
Promoted { baseline: crate::AlgorithmBaselineId, by: String, at: MissionTime, }
RolledBack { profile: crate::MissionProfile, restored: Option<crate::AlgorithmBaselineId>, by: String, at: MissionTime, }
PromotionRefused { baseline: crate::AlgorithmBaselineId, reason: String, at: MissionTime, }
ProductDue { name: String, kind: crate::ProductKind, due: MissionTime, }
ProductUndelivered { name: String, endpoint: String, reason: String, at: MissionTime, }
MaintenanceOpened { sensor: SensorId, until: MissionTime, reason: String, at: MissionTime, }
MaintenanceOverrun { sensor: SensorId, window_closed: MissionTime, reason: String, at: MissionTime, }
HandoverAcknowledged { by: String, period: (MissionTime, MissionTime), outstanding: bool, at: MissionTime, }
Tasked { requirement: RequirementId, task: SensorTaskId, by: Concurrence, at: MissionTime, }
Declined { requirement: RequirementId, by: Concurrence, reason: String, at: MissionTime, }
Satisfied { requirement: RequirementId, evidence: String, at: MissionTime, }

Decided { plan: PlanId, decision: DecisionId, accepted: bool, operator: Option<String>, role: Option<String>, verdict: VerdictSummary, rationale: Option<String>, request: Option<RequestId>, item: Option<PendingApprovalId>, overridden: bool, origin: Option<String>, acknowledged: Vec<crate::Acknowledgement>, }
Queued { item: PendingApprovalId, plan: PlanId, layer: EffectorLayer, offered_to: Vec<String>, expires_at: Option<MissionTime>, escalate_at: Option<MissionTime>, }
Escalated { plan: PlanId, to_role: String, at: MissionTime, }
Withdrawn { item: PendingApprovalId, plan: PlanId, layer: EffectorLayer, status: crate::WeaponsControlStatus, at: MissionTime, }
Opened { decision: DecisionId, plan: PlanId, track: TrackId, }
Closed { decision: DecisionId, outcome: String, at: MissionTime, }
Issued { decision: DecisionId, endpoint: Option<String>, at: MissionTime, }
Undelivered { decision: DecisionId, endpoint: String, reason: String, at: MissionTime, }
Delivered { decision: DecisionId, endpoint: String, attempts: u32, at: MissionTime, }
Refused { decision: DecisionId, endpoint: String, reason: String, at: MissionTime, }
Reported { decision: DecisionId, endpoint: String, report: crate::handoff::EffectorReport, at: MissionTime, }
Opened { session: crate::SessionId, operator: Option<String>, at: MissionTime, }
FindingRecorded { session: crate::SessionId, finding: u64, kind: String, refers_to: Option<MissionTime>, operator: Option<String>, at: MissionTime, }
FindingPromoted { session: crate::SessionId, finding: u64, gap: String, operator: Option<String>, at: MissionTime, }
Concluded { session: crate::SessionId, findings: usize, operator: Option<String>, at: MissionTime, }
Closed { session: crate::SessionId, operator: Option<String>, at: MissionTime, }
Changed { tracking_healthy: bool, intercept_healthy: bool, ingest_healthy: bool, at: MissionTime, }
ClockDiscipline { sensor: SensorId, state: crate::ClockDisciplineState, at: MissionTime, }
Raised { asset: crate::AssetId, track: crate::TrackId, due_by: MissionTime, at: MissionTime, }
Sent { asset: crate::AssetId, track: crate::TrackId, at: MissionTime, }
Acknowledged { asset: crate::AssetId, track: crate::TrackId, party: String, at: MissionTime, }
Failed { asset: crate::AssetId, track: crate::TrackId, reason: String, at: MissionTime, }
Late { asset: crate::AssetId, track: crate::TrackId, at: MissionTime, }
Waived { asset: crate::AssetId, track: crate::TrackId, operator: String, reason: String, at: MissionTime, }
Closed { asset: crate::AssetId, track: crate::TrackId, final_state: String, at: MissionTime, }
Refused { peer: String, reason: String, at: MissionTime, }
Purged { session: crate::SessionId, idle_days: f64, max_session_age_days: u32, bytes: u64, at: MissionTime, }
Anchored { head: AuditHead, closing: bool, at: MissionTime, }
Verified { heads: Vec<AuditHead>, segments: u64, entries: u64, findings: Vec<String>, unread_sessions: Vec<String>, at: MissionTime, }
Purged { segment: String, entries: u64, bytes: u64, idle_days: f64, max_audit_log_age_days: u32, completed: bool, at: MissionTime, }
Forwarded { party: String, head: AuditHead, verdict: AnchorVerdict, finding: Option<String>, at: MissionTime, }
ForwardedVerification { party: String, findings: Vec<String>, at: MissionTime, }
FellBack { endpoint: String, silent_s: f64, at: MissionTime, last_seq: u64, }
Restored { endpoint: String, fallback_since: MissionTime, at: MissionTime, }
SwitchedBack { endpoint: String, at: MissionTime, merged: usize, conflicts: usize, node_history: bool, }
ConflictResolved { plan: crate::PlanId, kept_local: bool, operator: Option<String>, at: MissionTime, }

ConflictArbitrated { plan: crate::PlanId, kept_local: bool, ground: crate::arbitration::ArbitrationGround, local: crate::arbitration::ConflictSide, remote: crate::arbitration::ConflictSide, at: MissionTime, }
BothActed { track: crate::TrackId, local: EngagementSide, remote: EngagementSide, at: MissionTime, }
DelegationsLapsed { endpoint: String, cut_off_since: MissionTime, lapse_s: Option<f64>, withdrawn: Vec<crate::PlanId>, at: MissionTime, }
GapAcceptanceReopened { acceptance: crate::GapAcceptanceId, because: crate::ReopenedBecause, at: MissionTime, }
Started { seed: String, seed_sha256: String, at: MissionTime, }
Closed { session: crate::SessionId, stepped: usize, at: MissionTime, }
ProductDue, ProductHeld, ProductUndelivered, HandoverAcknowledged, MaintenanceOpened, MaintenanceCompleted, MaintenanceOverrun
Issued, Manual, Undelivered, Delivered, Refused, Reported
Issued, Manual, Undelivered, Delivered, Refused, Reported
Raised, Sent, Acknowledged, Failed, Late, Waived, Closed
Raised, Sent, Acknowledged, Failed, Late, Waived, Closed
FellBack, Restored, SwitchedBack, ConflictResolved, ConflictArbitrated, BothActed, DelegationsLapsed
